perf(@formatjs/intl-localematcher): reuse immutable matcher snapshots (#7841)

NumberFormat construction checked its mutable locale Set, then checked
the private array copy again. Keep Set validation, but share a private
frozen snapshot with the prepared best-fit matcher. Public arrays retain
their existing validation; lookup does not build a best-fit snapshot.

Warm best-fit constructor benchmarks improve ~1.16–1.23× in Node.
Warm/cold lookup controls stay flat. Added constructor-only and
fresh-Set lanes; timings include `resolvedOptions()`. Raw samples cover
657 packs and 976 available locale IDs including aliases. Rust, locale
data and number arithmetic unchanged.

Nine local checks and [all 23 optimized Linux
checks](https://app.buildbuddy.io/invocation/eff8683a-db2c-4267-9864-de1fe69cc02c)
pass, including matcher ICU fixtures, shared polyfills, Rust/ICU parity,
four Test262 suites and Hermes package conformance. ICU snapshots
unchanged. Regressions cover Set prototype mutation, same-size alias
ordering, matcher switching, cross-realm Sets, frozen getter arrays and
inherited snapshot accessors.

[Full-suite
CI](https://formatjs.buildbuddy.io/invocation/36fb10b8-53a9-453c-8114-3907ca8242cf)
and hooks pass.
